Hey Dolores, I just saw you adding milk to your coffee—perfect timing! I was checking the time and realized we’re both ready to head to the cafe. I’ll bring the checklist for the oat milk latte station and make sure the scones are fresh. Want to grab a quick coffee together before it gets busy? I’ve been thinking about your seasonal cinnamon and cardamom blend—it really sparked the idea for our 'Cinnamon & Cardamom' menu item next month.

Thanks for starting this—really makes me feel like we’re building something special together.
